# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech for Personal Ventures](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): A reflective essay on quitting a stable tech job to pursue personal ambitions and build something meaningful.

## Projects

- [Claude Surf AI Development Tool](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): Orchestrator for autonomous software development using Claude AI agents and Linear integration
- [Fantasy IDL Prediction Game](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-fantasy-idl): Live dance crew competition prediction game with real-time scoring and leaderboards
